    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive complaint decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefund" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_Customer_NoRefund"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRefund" name="Receive refund" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback" name="Provide feedback?" default="Flow_Customer_SkipFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide satisfaction feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refundApproved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NoRefund" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_RefundReceived" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerOutcomeMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_ProvideFeedback" name="Customer provides feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customerChoosesToProvideFeedback</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_SkipFeedback" name="No feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback" targetRef="End_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackProvided"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ComplaintResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FinancialTeam" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of decision" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintResolved" name="Complaint resolved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_1" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_2" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssessComplaint"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundProcessed" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_6" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_7" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_ComplaintResolved"/>
  </bpmn:process>
